flavor.phonemic_palette: Fused Ge'ez-Old-English: emphatics t'/s'/q' meet th/ae; consonants t k s h n r w l m b g, sh, ch; vowels a e i o u + ae; endings fuse Ge'ez -a/-os with OE -en/-ing/-as; root stress.
flavor.phenotype_notes: Synthesis of Ethiopian + Anglo-Saxon per setting-lore §5.3 (blend the listed features; exclude the inverse).

magic_attitude.notes: Ethiopian + Anglo-Saxon register; deity-morphs in name_bank 'aethling'.

religion_hooks.alignment_lens: Resolved per the culture's chosen alignment (setting-lore §4.2): Lawful venerates the 12 Lawful powers and names the 13 as demons; Chaotic venerates the 13 and names the 12 as tyrant-gods; Neutral venerates this culture's ancestral saints, invoking the great gods only situationally.

flavor_text.one_line: Aethling — tolerant egalitarian of the savanna; law, knowledge.
flavor_text.one_paragraph: The Aethling (Ethiopian + Anglo-Saxon) are a defensive egalitarian people seeded in savanna, scrubland, hills. They prize law, knowledge, honor, lean toward the military sphere, and field heavy_infantry, archers, light_cavalry. Outsiders are met as tolerant; their patrons touch law, knowledge, trade.
